ModMetaData.name: Convergence: Races
ModMetaData.author: Prospero1088
ModMetaData.description:
Beast bloodlines for Convergence: Era of Cultivation.
Five bloodlines (Dragon, Phoenix, Qilin, Black Tortoise and Fox), each with four purities (trace, diluted, pure, ancestral), their own look, gifts and flaws, an innate ability and a xenotype. Bloodlines appear at random in the world, awaken with the Convergence and can be purified.
Requires Convergence: Era of Cultivation and Biotech.
